Oh! Is that...Maton Sword?!\nIt's really here!!
It was said that when Slebinia transitioned from\nan empire into a republic, Delma, a shogun who\nbecame the president, gave Maton Sword,
a machine-made monster, to Mithurna as a gift.\nIt was stationed at this castle to watch\nthe frontier and fortify defense...
W-what creature is that?!
It doesn't look like the\nDemi Machinas around here...\nCould it be a Coenubia, or maybe...
G-g-guys, I think this is bad.\nIt thinks we're its enemy...
Hold on!\nDon't attack!!
W-what do you mean?
I think it seems to realize that we're not\nbad guys...
It's not standing here for nothing, it's still\nmoving and really protecting this place...
I don't see anything extremely strange happening\naround here...I'd say that monster was the only\nthing that was kinda strange...
Since we don't find anything suspicious in\nparticular, shall we move on?
Thank you. Please take care...
